notes.title: Graphics Update
notes.notes:
Nature theme!

As a small surprise we have created a "nature" theme that will turn all levels into neat little forests filled with traps, foxes and bears! All the different animals are animated to bring a little bit more life into the game. An update with this will is now available for everyone and you can switch to the new theme in settings. 

We have also tweaked the apperance of a few elements in the original theme - the biggest change being the addition of gray sides to the fast red cube (see bellow) which should hopefully make it much easier to recognize (especially for our visually impaired players!).

For those of you who are eager to try the theme out, here is a little visual guide to make the transition easier:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/c0e5a0c8d00e358b335dabe6227c3c5d982d08ab.png

And don't worry, the mechanics of the game are still the same! You will of course be able to use the classic "cubes" theme if you want - it's entirely up to you! Let us know in the comments what you think about the new theme. Thank you!

notes.title: November Update
notes.notes:
Introduction

As promised in our updates roadmap we are releasing our first major content update for Cubiscape 2. See bellow for what you will find in this release. We are also looking for more feedback so we know what to focus on in future updates. We read every comment and review - your opinion is very valuable to us!

[hr][/hr]

New Features

Steam Achievements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/31db926391cec8857d5b063299680680074ba785.jpg

This was the most requested feature by far so we are pleased to announce that now you can earn over 20 achievements by playing the main campaign and solving random puzzles!

Leaderboards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958906/0f86957e53ad2b223bd523fead1ffb5018279f49.png

To bring a bit of competitiveness to random levels we are introducing the Leaderboard feature that will track the most capable players across all platforms. You will find the leaderboards directly in the "Random" menu. There is a separate table for each of the four difficulties. Those players that solve the most levels in the last 7 days will appear in the leaderboards - so go out there and earn those bragging rights!

Note: this feature is still in Beta and we will be closely monitoring it for any potential problems. The leaderboards update roughly every hour, so it might take some time before you see your latest score.

New (sort of) campaign chapters

As promised the campaign got two more chapters added to it. Unfortunately we rolled out this feature a week earlier than intended and the quality of the content was not up to par. We apologize for that. This is now resolved - and don't worry, if you already completed some (or all!) of the levels, you will not lose your progress.

[hr][/hr]

Other improvements


 Better tutorial
 General UI improvements
 Several other under the hood fixes


[hr][/hr]

That's it for today. We are already working on more improvements to the game and will be ready to share more details in the coming weeks. Stay tuned!
